comment: F31 code-signing policy for the NATIVE Windows client. Signing is a POST-BUILD step over the artifacts that native/installer/build-installer.ps1 produces (staged remcord.exe + dist setup exe). remcord.iss, build-installer.ps1, and check-installer.ps1 stay signing-free by contract (check-installer §7 asserts no signtool claims in the installer definition). No private key material ever lives in this repo.

artifacts.description: Staged release executable (copied from native/target/release/remcord.exe by build-installer.ps1).
Inno Setup output. {version} expands from the package.json version field (single source, same as build-installer.ps1).

azureTrustedSigning.description: Recommended for CI. Endpoint + account + certificate profile come from secrets; authentication is a Microsoft Entra service principal. Nothing is downloaded from third-party domains.

pfx.description: OV/EV code-signing certificate as base64 PFX in a secret, or a local file path passed explicitly. URL sources are refused.

releaseRequiresSignatureNote: false matches the CURRENT reality (unsigned native builds, same as unsigned Electron builds — checklist D/F31). Flip to true only together with: a real certificate in CI secrets, a populated pfx.subjectAllowlist, and a signed release run whose Confirm-ArtifactSignatures.ps1 output is pasted as evidence. Never flip on a self-signed test certificate.
allowUnsignedNote: Local/dev escape hatch only. When releaseRequiresSignature is true, an unsigned artifact fails the gate unless this variable is explicitly set to '1' AND the run is not CI (GITHUB_ACTIONS unset). CI never honors the escape hatch.
